config.marker_scope: All biallelic segregating variants; archaic annotation is not required for this conventional iHS benchmark
config.normalization: 400 neutral fit regions, separate 400 neutral calibration regions and 200 held-out neutral regions per fold
config.primary_endpoint: Matched focal coordinate (nearest scorable core within 5 kb), and a fixed centered 100 kb window; calibration uses the identical local score in neutrals
config.raw_sign: ln(iHH_ALT / iHH_REF); regional statistics use absolute standardized iHS
